items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Norman told me that it wasn't the kind that hurt your ears.

ctx.x: Well, you know, he knew the instrument and he could play. But he was a solid trumpet player.

Oh. That he had. Even on those old primitive records, his power is fantastic. He was, he was, he was terrific. You say he was the best hot trumpet you've heard? Yes, and with power, you know, hit. Norman told me that it wasn't the kind that hurt your ears.
It just went through the roof.
